items.title: The Hidden Turbulence Priced Into Accenture Stock
items.summary: Beneath its blue-chip reputation, the market is pricing a notably wide range of outcomes for the consulting giant, a risk you carry whether you trade options or not.

items.title: ACN Stock: Why The Discount May Not Last
items.summary: At $185.28, Accenture (ACN) looks set up for roughly 44% of upside over the next three years under a moderate recovery scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. The upside is powered primarily by steady earnings growth, while a modest re-rating from depressed multiples provides an additional tailwind.
